```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# ===========================
# Load required libraries
# ===========================
library(readr)
library(pheatmap)
library(dplyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(tibble)
library(patchwork)
library(FactoMineR)
library(factoextra)
library(tidyr)
library(haven)
library(stringr)

# ===========================
# Define generic paths
# ===========================
input_dir         <- "C:/Users/socla/Documents/data/Datos_finales"
clinicrawdata_dir <- "C:/Users/socla/Documents/data/Rawdata"
output_dir        <- "C:/Users/socla/Documents/results/06_Results_Log2_Heatmap_PCA/"

if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) dir.create(output_dir)

# ===========================
# Required input files
# ===========================
expr_file   <- file.path(input_dir, "final_normalized_matrix.csv")
clinic_file <- file.path(clinicrawdata_dir, "Base retrospectiva HERMION 6MAIG2026 julia TFM.sav")
```

```{r data_preparation}
# Load data
gene_expr <- read_csv(expr_file)
clinic_db <- read_sav(clinic_file) %>% zap_labels()

# ===========================
# Transpose and clean the matrix
# ===========================
gene_expr_t <- as.data.frame(t(gene_expr), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(gene_expr_t) <- gene_expr_t[1, ]
gene_expr_t <- gene_expr_t[-1, ]
gene_expr_t[] <- lapply(gene_expr_t, function(x) as.numeric(as.character(x)))

# Apply log2 pseudocounts (avoid -Inf)
min_no_zero <- min(gene_expr_t[gene_expr_t > 0], na.rm = TRUE)
gene_expr_t_log2 <- log2(gene_expr_t + (min_no_zero / 2))
gene_expr_t_log2 <- tibble::rownames_to_column(gene_expr_t_log2, var = "Sample_Name")

# ===========================
# Extract Codi_Noray from sample name
# ===========================
# "20260304_IO360RunA_HON2414_09.RCC" -> "HON2414"
gene_expr_t_log2$Codi_Noray <- str_extract(gene_expr_t_log2$Sample_Name, "HON\\d+")

cat("Extraction examples:\n")
head(gene_expr_t_log2[, c("Sample_Name", "Codi_Noray")])

n_match <- sum(gene_expr_t_log2$Codi_Noray %in% clinic_db$Codi_Noray)
cat(sprintf("\nSamples with match: %d / %d\n", n_match, nrow(gene_expr_t_log2)))

# ===========================
# Sort and merge with clinical database
# ===========================
clinic_db_sorted <- clinic_db[order(match(clinic_db$Codi_Noray, gene_expr_t_log2$Codi_Noray)), ]
db_completa_log2 <- merge(clinic_db_sorted, gene_expr_t_log2, by = "Codi_Noray")

idx <- which(names(db_completa_log2) == "Beneficio_clinico_a_6mo_inicioIT")
names(db_completa_log2)[idx] <- "clinical_benefit"

write.csv(db_completa_log2, file = file.path(output_dir, "db_completa_log2.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# ===========================
# Shared derived variables (used across heatmaps)
# ===========================
pSTAT3_cat <- cut(
  db_completa_log2$pSTAT3_Histoscore,
  breaks = c(-Inf, 29, 73, Inf),
  labels = c("low", "intermediate", "high"),
  right  = TRUE
)

resposta_terapeutica <- dplyr::case_when(
  db_completa_log2$Mejor_respuesta_a_IT %in% c(0, 1) ~ "Responder",
  db_completa_log2$Mejor_respuesta_a_IT %in% c(2, 3) ~ "No Responder",
  TRUE ~ NA_character_
)

# ===========================
# Shared annotation colors
# ===========================
annotation_colors_full <- list(
  Clinical_Benefit     = c("Benefit" = "#9A32CD", "No Benefit" = "#00CED1"),
  Resposta_Clinica     = c("RC" = "hotpink2", "RP" = "gold1",
                           "EE" = "blue", "PE" = "steelblue3", "NE" = "grey"),
  Resposta_Terapeutica = c("Responder" = "yellowgreen", "No Responder" = "salmon2"),
  PDL1                 = c("Positive" = "orange", "Negative" = "dodgerblue", "Unknown" = "grey"),
  CavOral              = c("Yes" = "khaki", "No" = "olivedrab"),
  pSTAT3_Histoscore    = c("low" = "plum", "intermediate" = "rosybrown", "high" = "maroon")
)
```

```{r Heatmap_log2_zscored}
# ===========================
# Select endogenous genes only
# ===========================
expr_matrix <- db_completa_log2 %>%
  dplyr::select(Codi_Noray, starts_with("Endogenous_")) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "Codi_Noray") %>%
  as.matrix()

annotation_df_exploratory <- data.frame(
  row.names            = db_completa_log2$Codi_Noray,
  Clinical_Benefit     = factor(db_completa_log2$clinical_benefit,
                                levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("Benefit", "No Benefit")),
  Resposta_Clinica     = factor(db_completa_log2$Mejor_respuesta_a_IT,
                                levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4), labels = c("RC", "RP", "EE", "PE", "NE")),
  Resposta_Terapeutica = factor(resposta_terapeutica, levels = c("Responder", "No Responder")),
  PDL1                 = factor(db_completa_log2$PDL1,
                                levels = c(1, 0, 2), labels = c("Positive", "Negative", "Unknown")),
  CavOral              = factor(db_completa_log2$CavOral_si_no,
                                levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("Yes", "No")),
  pSTAT3_Histoscore    = pSTAT3_cat
)

heatmap_args_exploratory <- list(
  mat               = expr_matrix,
  annotation_row    = annotation_df_exploratory,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors_full[names(annotation_df_exploratory)],
  color             = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(100),
  cluster_rows      = TRUE,
  cluster_cols      = TRUE,
  scale             = "column",
  show_rownames     = TRUE,
  show_colnames     = FALSE,
  fontsize_row      = 6,
  main              = "Gene Expression Heatmap (log2, Z-score per gene)",
  border_color      = NA
)

pdf(file.path(output_dir, "Heatmap_exploratory.pdf"), width = 15, height = 10)
do.call(pheatmap, heatmap_args_exploratory)
dev.off()

do.call(pheatmap, heatmap_args_exploratory)
```

```{r Heatmap_ALBA_signature}
# ===========================
# Select only the 5 ALBA signature genes
# ===========================
alba_genes <- c("IDO1", "CD38", "CXCL13", "CD27", "PNOC")

alba_cols <- sapply(alba_genes, function(g) {
  hits <- grep(paste0("Endogenous_", g, "_"), colnames(db_completa_log2), value = TRUE)
  if (length(hits) == 0) stop(paste("Gen no trobat:", g))
  if (length(hits) > 1)  warning(paste("Múltiples coincidències per:", g, "→ s'usa la primera:", hits[1]))
  hits[1]
})

expr_matrix_alba <- db_completa_log2 %>%
  dplyr::select(Codi_Noray, all_of(unname(alba_cols))) %>%
  tibble::column_to_rownames(var = "Codi_Noray") %>%
  as.matrix()
colnames(expr_matrix_alba) <- alba_genes

annotation_df_alba <- data.frame(
  row.names            = db_completa_log2$Codi_Noray,
  Clinical_Benefit     = factor(db_completa_log2$clinical_benefit,
                                levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("Benefit", "No Benefit")),
  Resposta_Clinica     = factor(db_completa_log2$Mejor_respuesta_a_IT,
                                levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4), labels = c("RC", "RP", "EE", "PE", "NE")),
  Resposta_Terapeutica = factor(resposta_terapeutica, levels = c("Responder", "No Responder")),
  PDL1                 = factor(db_completa_log2$PDL1,
                                levels = c(1, 0, 2), labels = c("Positive", "Negative", "Unknown")),
  CavOral              = factor(db_completa_log2$CavOral_si_no,
                                levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("Yes", "No")),
  pSTAT3_Histoscore    = pSTAT3_cat
)

heatmap_args_alba <- list(
  mat               = expr_matrix_alba,
  annotation_row    = annotation_df_alba,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors_full,
  color             = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(100),
  cluster_rows      = TRUE,
  cluster_cols      = TRUE,
  scale             = "column",
  show_rownames     = TRUE,
  show_colnames     = TRUE,
  fontsize_row      = 6,
  fontsize_col      = 11,
  main              = "ALBA Signature – Gene Expression (log2, Z-score per gene)",
  border_color      = NA
)

pdf(file.path(output_dir, "Heatmap_ALBA_signature.pdf"), width = 8, height = 10)
do.call(pheatmap, heatmap_args_alba)
dev.off()

pheatmap_obj <- do.call(pheatmap, heatmap_args_alba)
grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(pheatmap_obj$gtable)
```



```{r Heatmap_PDL1pos_pSTAT3high}
# ===========================
# Filter: PDL1 positive AND pSTAT3 high
# ===========================
mask_pdl1_stat3 <- db_completa_log2$PDL1 == 1 & pSTAT3_cat == "high"
db_filtered <- db_completa_log2[mask_pdl1_stat3, ]
pSTAT3_cat_filtered <- pSTAT3_cat[mask_pdl1_stat3]

# Eliminar el NA de Codi_Noray
na_idx <- is.na(db_filtered$Codi_Noray)
db_filtered <- db_filtered[!na_idx, ]
pSTAT3_cat_filtered <- pSTAT3_cat_filtered[!na_idx]

cat(sprintf("Pacients PDL1+ i pSTAT3 high (sense NA): %d / %d\n",
            nrow(db_filtered), nrow(db_completa_log2)))

# ===========================
# Select target genes
# ===========================
target_genes <- c("IL24", "PRKX", "TWIST2", "WNT10A")

target_cols <- sapply(target_genes, function(g) {
  hits <- grep(paste0("Endogenous_", g, "_"), colnames(db_filtered), value = TRUE)
  if (length(hits) == 0) stop(paste("Gen no trobat:", g))
  if (length(hits) > 1)  warning(paste("Múltiples coincidències per:", g, "→ s'usa la primera:", hits[1]))
  hits[1]
})

# Construcció manual de la matriu
tmp <- db_filtered %>%
  dplyr::select(Codi_Noray, all_of(unname(target_cols))) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(tmp) <- tmp$Codi_Noray
tmp$Codi_Noray <- NULL
expr_matrix_filtered <- as.matrix(tmp)
colnames(expr_matrix_filtered) <- target_genes

# ===========================
# Annotation: Clinical Benefit + Resposta Clínica
# ===========================
annotation_df_filtered <- data.frame(
  row.names        = db_filtered$Codi_Noray,
  Clinical_Benefit = factor(db_filtered$clinical_benefit,
                            levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("Benefit", "No Benefit")),
  Resposta_Clinica = factor(db_filtered$Mejor_respuesta_a_IT,
                            levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4), labels = c("RC", "RP", "EE", "PE", "NE"))
)

heatmap_args_filtered <- list(
  mat               = expr_matrix_filtered,
  annotation_row    = annotation_df_filtered,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors_full[names(annotation_df_filtered)],
  color             = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(100),
  cluster_rows      = TRUE,
  cluster_cols      = TRUE,
  scale             = "column",
  show_rownames     = TRUE,
  show_colnames     = TRUE,
  fontsize_row      = 8,
  fontsize_col      = 11,
  fontsize          = 10,
  main              = "PDL1+ & pSTAT3 high – Gene Expression (log2, Z-score per gene)",
  border_color      = NA
)

png(file.path(output_dir, "Heatmap_PDL1pos_pSTAT3high.png"), width = 7, height = 8,
    units = "in", res = 300)
do.call(pheatmap, heatmap_args_filtered)
dev.off()

pheatmap_obj_filtered <- do.call(pheatmap, heatmap_args_filtered)
grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(pheatmap_obj_filtered$gtable)
```

```{r Heatmap_fullcohort_target_genes_supervised}
# ===========================
# Full cohort – WNT10A, IL24, PRKX, TWIST2 (supervised)
# ===========================
target_genes_full <- c("IL24", "PRKX", "TWIST2", "WNT10A")
target_cols_full <- sapply(target_genes_full, function(g) {
  hits <- grep(paste0("Endogenous_", g, "_"), colnames(db_completa_log2), value = TRUE)
  if (length(hits) == 0) stop(paste("Gen no trobat:", g))
  if (length(hits) > 1)  warning(paste("Múltiples coincidències per:", g, "→ s'usa la primera:", hits[1]))
  hits[1]
})

tmp_full <- db_completa_log2 %>%
  dplyr::select(Codi_Noray, all_of(unname(target_cols_full))) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(tmp_full) <- tmp_full$Codi_Noray
tmp_full$Codi_Noray <- NULL
expr_matrix_full_target <- as.matrix(tmp_full)
colnames(expr_matrix_full_target) <- target_genes_full

# ===========================
# Ordenació supervisada: PDL1 → pSTAT3 → Clinical Benefit
# ===========================
pdl1_order    <- c("Positive", "Unknown", "Negative")
pstat3_order  <- c("high", "intermediate", "low")
benefit_order <- c("Benefit", "No Benefit")

recode_pdl1 <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "Unknown",
  ifelse(x == 1,   "Positive",
  ifelse(x == 0,   "Negative", "Unknown")))
}

sort_key <- data.frame(
  Codi_Noray   = db_completa_log2$Codi_Noray,
  PDL1_sort    = factor(recode_pdl1(db_completa_log2$PDL1), levels = pdl1_order),
  pSTAT3_sort  = factor(pSTAT3_cat, levels = pstat3_order),
  Benefit_sort = factor(
    ifelse(db_completa_log2$clinical_benefit == 1, "Benefit", "No Benefit"),
    levels = benefit_order
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
sort_key <- sort_key[order(sort_key$PDL1_sort, sort_key$pSTAT3_sort, sort_key$Benefit_sort), ]

# ── Ajust manual: mou HON2528 just davant de HON2518 ──────────────────────────
ordered_ids  <- sort_key$Codi_Noray
idx_2528     <- which(ordered_ids == "HON2528")
idx_2518     <- which(ordered_ids == "HON2518")
ordered_ids  <- ordered_ids[-idx_2528]
idx_2518_new <- which(ordered_ids == "HON2518")
ordered_ids  <- append(ordered_ids, "HON2528", after = idx_2518_new - 1)
sort_key     <- sort_key[match(ordered_ids, sort_key$Codi_Noray), ]
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Aplicar l'ordre a la matriu
expr_matrix_full_target <- expr_matrix_full_target[sort_key$Codi_Noray, ]

# ===========================
# Annotation row
# ===========================
idx <- match(sort_key$Codi_Noray, db_completa_log2$Codi_Noray)
annotation_df_full_target <- data.frame(
  row.names        = sort_key$Codi_Noray,
  PDL1             = factor(recode_pdl1(db_completa_log2$PDL1[idx]), levels = pdl1_order),
  pSTAT3_Histoscore = factor(as.character(pSTAT3_cat[idx]), levels = pstat3_order),
  Clinical_Benefit = factor(
    ifelse(db_completa_log2$clinical_benefit[idx] == 1, "Benefit", "No Benefit"),
    levels = benefit_order
  )
)

# ===========================
# Generar heatmap
# ===========================
heatmap_args_supervised <- list(
  mat               = expr_matrix_full_target,
  annotation_row    = annotation_df_full_target,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors_full,
  cluster_rows      = FALSE,
  cluster_cols      = TRUE,
  scale             = "column",
  color             = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(100),
  main              = "Full Cohort – WNT10A, IL24, PRKX, TWIST2\n(supervised: PDL1 → pSTAT3 → Clinical Benefit)",
  fontsize_row      = 7,
  fontsize_col      = 10,
  border_color      = NA,
  filename          = file.path(output_dir, "heatmap_fullcohort_target_supervised.png"),
  width             = 8,
  height            = 6
)
do.call(pheatmap, heatmap_args_supervised)
```

```{r Heatmap_fullcohort_target_genes_supervised}
# ===========================
# Full cohort – WNT10A, IL24, PRKX, TWIST2 (supervised)
# ===========================
target_genes_full <- c("IL24", "PRKX", "TWIST2", "WNT10A")
target_cols_full <- sapply(target_genes_full, function(g) {
  hits <- grep(paste0("Endogenous_", g, "_"), colnames(db_completa_log2), value = TRUE)
  if (length(hits) == 0) stop(paste("Gen no trobat:", g))
  if (length(hits) > 1)  warning(paste("Múltiples coincidències per:", g, "→ s'usa la primera:", hits[1]))
  hits[1]
})

tmp_full <- db_completa_log2 %>%
  dplyr::select(Codi_Noray, all_of(unname(target_cols_full))) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(tmp_full) <- tmp_full$Codi_Noray
tmp_full$Codi_Noray <- NULL
expr_matrix_full_target <- as.matrix(tmp_full)
colnames(expr_matrix_full_target) <- target_genes_full

# ===========================
# Ordenació supervisada: PDL1 → pSTAT3 → Clinical Benefit
# ===========================
pdl1_order    <- c("Positive", "Unknown", "Negative")
pstat3_order  <- c("high", "intermediate", "low")
benefit_order <- c("Benefit", "No Benefit")
response_order <- c("CR", "PR", "SD", "PD")

recode_pdl1 <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "Unknown",
  ifelse(x == 1,   "Positive",
  ifelse(x == 0,   "Negative", "Unknown")))
}

response_recode <- c("0" = "CR", "1" = "PR", "2" = "SD", "3" = "PD")

sort_key <- data.frame(
  Codi_Noray   = db_completa_log2$Codi_Noray,
  PDL1_sort    = factor(recode_pdl1(db_completa_log2$PDL1), levels = pdl1_order),
  pSTAT3_sort  = factor(pSTAT3_cat, levels = pstat3_order),
  Benefit_sort = factor(
    ifelse(db_completa_log2$clinical_benefit == 1, "Benefit", "No Benefit"),
    levels = benefit_order
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
sort_key <- sort_key[order(sort_key$PDL1_sort, sort_key$pSTAT3_sort, sort_key$Benefit_sort), ]

# ── Ajust manual: mou HON2528 just davant de HON2518 ──────────────────────────
ordered_ids  <- sort_key$Codi_Noray
idx_2528     <- which(ordered_ids == "HON2528")
idx_2518     <- which(ordered_ids == "HON2518")
ordered_ids  <- ordered_ids[-idx_2528]
idx_2518_new <- which(ordered_ids == "HON2518")
ordered_ids  <- append(ordered_ids, "HON2528", after = idx_2518_new - 1)
sort_key     <- sort_key[match(ordered_ids, sort_key$Codi_Noray), ]
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

# Aplicar l'ordre a la matriu
expr_matrix_full_target <- expr_matrix_full_target[sort_key$Codi_Noray, ]

# ===========================
# Annotation row
# ===========================
idx <- match(sort_key$Codi_Noray, db_completa_log2$Codi_Noray)

annotation_colors_full$Response <- c(
  "CR" = "hotpink2",
  "PR" = "gold1",
  "SD" = "blue",
  "PD" = "steelblue3"
)

annotation_df_full_target <- data.frame(
  row.names         = sort_key$Codi_Noray,
  PDL1              = factor(recode_pdl1(db_completa_log2$PDL1[idx]), levels = pdl1_order),
  pSTAT3_Histoscore = factor(as.character(pSTAT3_cat[idx]), levels = pstat3_order),
  Clinical_Benefit  = factor(
    ifelse(db_completa_log2$clinical_benefit[idx] == 1, "Benefit", "No Benefit"),
    levels = benefit_order
  ),
  Response          = factor(
    response_recode[as.character(zap_labels(db_completa_log2$Mejor_respuesta_a_IT)[idx])],
    levels = response_order
  )
)

# ===========================
# Generar heatmap
# ===========================
heatmap_args_supervised <- list(
  mat               = expr_matrix_full_target,
  annotation_row    = annotation_df_full_target,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors_full,
  cluster_rows      = FALSE,
  cluster_cols      = TRUE,
  scale             = "column",
  color             = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(100),
  main              = "Full Cohort – WNT10A, IL24, PRKX, TWIST2\n(supervised: PDL1 → pSTAT3 → Clinical Benefit)",
  fontsize_row      = 7,
  fontsize_col      = 10,
  border_color      = NA,
  filename          = file.path(output_dir, "heatmap_fullcohort_target_supervised.png"),
  width             = 8,
  height            = 6
)
do.call(pheatmap, heatmap_args_supervised)
```

```{r Heatmap_fullcohort_selected_genes}
# ===========================
# Full cohort – WNT10A, IL24
# ===========================
target_genes_full <- c("IL24", "WNT10A")

target_cols_full <- sapply(target_genes_full, function(g) {
  hits <- grep(paste0("Endogenous_", g, "_"), colnames(db_completa_log2), value = TRUE)
  if (length(hits) == 0) stop(paste("Gen no trobat:", g))
  if (length(hits) > 1)  warning(paste("Múltiples coincidències per:", g, "→ s'usa la primera:", hits[1]))
  hits[1]
})

tmp_full <- db_completa_log2 %>%
  dplyr::select(Codi_Noray, all_of(unname(target_cols_full))) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(tmp_full) <- tmp_full$Codi_Noray
tmp_full$Codi_Noray <- NULL
expr_matrix_full_target <- as.matrix(tmp_full)
colnames(expr_matrix_full_target) <- target_genes_full

# ===========================
# Annotation: PDL1 + Clinical Benefit
# ===========================
annotation_df_full_target <- data.frame(
  row.names        = db_completa_log2$Codi_Noray,
  Clinical_Benefit = factor(db_completa_log2$clinical_benefit,
                            levels = c(1, 0), labels = c("Benefit", "No Benefit")),
  PDL1             = factor(db_completa_log2$PDL1,
                            levels = c(1, 0, 2), labels = c("Positive", "Negative", "Unknown")),
  pSTAT3_Histoscore    = pSTAT3_cat
)

heatmap_args_full_target <- list(
  mat               = expr_matrix_full_target,
  annotation_row    = annotation_df_full_target,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors_full[names(annotation_df_full_target)],
  color             = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(100),
  cluster_rows      = TRUE,
  cluster_cols      = TRUE,
  scale             = "column",
  show_rownames     = TRUE,
  show_colnames     = TRUE,
  fontsize_row      = 8,
  fontsize_col      = 11,
  fontsize          = 10,
  main              = "Full Cohort – WNT10A, IL24, (log2, Z-score per gene)",
  border_color      = NA
)

png(file.path(output_dir, "Heatmap_fullcohort_selected_genes.png"), width = 7, height = 8,
    units = "in", res = 300)
do.call(pheatmap, heatmap_args_full_target)
dev.off()

pheatmap_obj_full_target <- do.call(pheatmap, heatmap_args_full_target)
grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(pheatmap_obj_full_target$gtable)
```

```{r heatmap_supervised_upregulatedgenes_pSTAT3high_cohort}
# ===========================
# Full cohort – HLA-DRB5, HLA-DQA1, HLA-DQB1, KIR3DL2, REN, IL21R (supervised)
# ===========================
target_genes_full <- c("HLA-DRB5", "HLA-DQA1", "HLA-DQB1", "KIR3DL2")
target_cols_full <- sapply(target_genes_full, function(g) {
  hits <- grep(paste0("Endogenous_", g, "_"), colnames(db_completa_log2), value = TRUE)
  if (length(hits) == 0) stop(paste("Gen no trobat:", g))
  if (length(hits) > 1)  warning(paste("Múltiples coincidències per:", g, "→ s'usa la primera:", hits[1]))
  hits[1]
})

tmp_full <- db_completa_log2 %>%
  dplyr::select(Codi_Noray, all_of(unname(target_cols_full))) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(tmp_full) <- tmp_full$Codi_Noray
tmp_full$Codi_Noray <- NULL
expr_matrix_full_target <- as.matrix(tmp_full)
colnames(expr_matrix_full_target) <- target_genes_full

# ===========================
# Ordenació supervisada: PDL1 → pSTAT3 → Clinical Benefit → Response
# ===========================
pdl1_order     <- c("Positive", "Unknown", "Negative")
pstat3_order   <- c("high", "intermediate", "low")
benefit_order  <- c("Benefit", "No Benefit")
response_order <- c("CR", "PR", "SD", "PD")

recode_pdl1 <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "Unknown",
  ifelse(x == 1,   "Positive",
  ifelse(x == 0,   "Negative", "Unknown")))
}

response_recode <- c("0" = "CR", "1" = "PR", "2" = "SD", "3" = "PD")

sort_key <- data.frame(
  Codi_Noray    = db_completa_log2$Codi_Noray,
  PDL1_sort     = factor(recode_pdl1(db_completa_log2$PDL1), levels = pdl1_order),
  pSTAT3_sort   = factor(pSTAT3_cat, levels = pstat3_order),
  Benefit_sort  = factor(
    ifelse(db_completa_log2$clinical_benefit == 1, "Benefit", "No Benefit"),
    levels = benefit_order
  ),
  Response_sort = factor(
    response_recode[as.character(zap_labels(db_completa_log2$Mejor_respuesta_a_IT))],
    levels = response_order
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
sort_key <- sort_key[order(sort_key$pSTAT3_sort, sort_key$PDL1_sort,
                           sort_key$Benefit_sort, sort_key$Response_sort), ]

# Aplicar l'ordre a la matriu
expr_matrix_full_target <- expr_matrix_full_target[sort_key$Codi_Noray, ]

# ===========================
# Annotation row
# ===========================
idx <- match(sort_key$Codi_Noray, db_completa_log2$Codi_Noray)

annotation_colors_full$Response <- c(
  "CR" = "hotpink2",
  "PR" = "gold1",
  "SD" = "blue",
  "PD" = "steelblue3"
)

annotation_df_full_target <- data.frame(
  row.names         = sort_key$Codi_Noray,
  pSTAT3_Histoscore = factor(as.character(pSTAT3_cat[idx]), levels = pstat3_order),
  PDL1              = factor(recode_pdl1(db_completa_log2$PDL1[idx]), levels = pdl1_order),
  Clinical_Benefit  = factor(
    ifelse(db_completa_log2$clinical_benefit[idx] == 1, "Benefit", "No Benefit"),
    levels = benefit_order
  ),
  Response          = factor(
    response_recode[as.character(zap_labels(db_completa_log2$Mejor_respuesta_a_IT)[idx])],
    levels = response_order
  )
)

# ===========================
# Generar heatmap
# ===========================
heatmap_args_supervised <- list(
  mat               = expr_matrix_full_target,
  annotation_row    = annotation_df_full_target,
  annotation_colors = annotation_colors_full,
  cluster_rows      = FALSE,
  cluster_cols      = TRUE,
  scale             = "column",
  color             = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(100),
  main              = "Full Cohort – HLA-DRB5, HLA-DQA1, HLA-DQB1, KIR3DL2, REN, IL21R\n(supervised: PDL1 → pSTAT3 → Clinical Benefit → Response)",
  fontsize_row      = 7,
  fontsize_col      = 10,
  border_color      = NA,
  filename          = file.path(output_dir, "heatmap_fullcohort_HLA_signature_supervised.png"),
  width             = 8,
  height            = 6
)
do.call(pheatmap, heatmap_args_supervised)
```

```{r PCA}
# ===========================
# Prepare endogenous expression matrix
# ===========================
endogenous_cols <- grep("^Endogenous", names(db_completa_log2), value = TRUE)
gene_expression <- db_completa_log2[, endogenous_cols] %>% mutate_all(as.numeric)

gene_expression[] <- lapply(gene_expression, function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), median(x, na.rm = TRUE), x)
})

scaled_expression <- scale(gene_expression)
rownames(scaled_expression) <- db_completa_log2$ID
pca.results <- PCA(scaled_expression, graph = FALSE, ncp = 10)

# ===========================
# Explained variance table
# ===========================
explained_variance <- pca.results$eig[, 2] / 100
variance_table <- data.frame(
  PC         = paste0("PC", 1:length(explained_variance)),
  Variance   = round(explained_variance, 3),
  Cumulative = round(cumsum(explained_variance), 3)
)
print(variance_table)
write.csv(variance_table, file.path(output_dir, "PCA_variance_explained.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

# ===========================
# Top contributing genes to PC1 and PC2
# ===========================
loadings <- as.data.frame(pca.results$var$contrib[, 1:2])
colnames(loadings) <- c("Contrib_PC1", "Contrib_PC2")
loadings$Gene <- rownames(loadings)
loadings <- loadings %>% arrange(desc(Contrib_PC1))

cat("\n--- Top 20 genes contributing to PC1 ---\n")
print(head(loadings, 20))
write.csv(loadings, file.path(output_dir, "PCA_gene_contributions.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r PCA_function}
# ===========================
# Reusable function: PCA plot colored by any clinical variable
# ===========================
plot_pca_by_var <- function(pca_results,
                            clinical_var,
                            var_levels,
                            var_labels,
                            colors,
                            title,
                            legend_title,
                            explained_variance,
                            ids = NULL) {
  pca_data <- as.data.frame(pca_results$ind$coord[, 1:2])
  pca_data$Group <- factor(clinical_var, levels = var_levels, labels = var_labels)
  if (!is.null(ids)) pca_data$ID <- ids
  pca_data <- pca_data[!is.na(pca_data$Group), ]

  ggplot(pca_data, aes(x = Dim.1, y = Dim.2, color = Group)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
    stat_ellipse(level = 0.95, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.7) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x     = paste0("PC1 (", round(explained_variance[1] * 100, 1), "%)"),
      y     = paste0("PC2 (", round(explained_variance[2] * 100, 1), "%)"),
      color = legend_title
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
}
```
